k_rule: highest silhouette over k=2..6 among k whose smallest segment has >= 3 districts; tie goes to the smaller k (fixed before results were seen)

segments.name: close to the state middle on every feature

decision_rule: median bootstrap ARI >= 0.6 -> descriptive typology; otherwise exploratory, no stable clusters claimed
limits: n = 30 districts: a typology for orientation, not a discovery or a forecast.

Rain level, variability and autumn share are ERA5 reanalysis at one grid point per district (2001-2025), not gauge counts; the trend is the IMD-based Sen slope index (1981-2025). No IMD mm value is published.
Hospital distance is straight-line to the nearest OSM hospital (D195); OSM is thinner in rural areas.
Segment names describe each centroid against the state middle; they are not causes.
